## bug

- **Never let 0 (or "") mean both 'unset' and a real value: use None for unset.** When a numeric or string option has a default, represent 'not given' as None on every surface (argparse default=None, MCP a.get(k) is None) and validate the explicit value; `x or DEFAULT` silently turns an explicit 0/'' into the default, and in a safety tool that flips the answer in the unsafe direction. _(first paragraph)_ `[L-B22-minzero]`
- **A 'last line is the max' shortcut only holds while a file has exactly one writer; merge=union silently gives it two.** Any O(1) summary read from an append-only file's tail (clock, counter, high-water mark) is valid only under a single-writer invariant. If the file is ever combined by merge=union, sync, or copy from another clone, that invariant is gone and nothing on disk records it: derive the summary from the whole (cached) content, and make identities that name a writer unique per clone, not just per host and … _(first paragraph)_ `[L-B28589b8b26]`

## ddflow

- **With parallel agents, never file a task under the 'next' sequential id: check it is free, or use a descriptive id.** Several agents file B-numbers concurrently and task add overwrites an existing id without error, so 'the next free number' guessed from one agent's view clobbers another agent's item (even a running one). Before task add, confirm the id is unused (`ddflow show <id>` must fail), and prefer a descriptive id (B-json-failures) that no other agent will pick. _(first paragraph)_ `[L-free-id-before-add]`

## gates

- **A gate command is read from the primary checkout but runs with the item branch's dependencies: merge main before unit_tests after the gate config changes.** Before running the unit_tests gate, merge the base branch into the item branch whenever main changed .ddflow/config.toml's gate commands or the dev dependencies (e.g. the pytest-xdist '-n 48' change, 8fe68e6). _(first paragraph)_ `[L-gate-cmd-vs-branch-deps]`

## git

- **git grep -o undercounts with many -F patterns: re-match whole lines instead.** To learn WHICH of many fixed-string patterns occur, run git grep without -o and re-match the returned lines in Python _(first paragraph)_ `[L5808fe73f8]`

## queue

- **With several agents on one queue, file items under descriptive ids (B-<slug>), never the next free number.** Before 'task add', pick an id derived from the work (B-add-refuses-dup-id, BUG-companions), not max(B<n>)+1, and 'ddflow show <id>' first _(first paragraph)_ `[L07ad0f5dd2]`
